PROFILE::fastL4
       Returns the value of a Fast L4 profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::fastL4 ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Fast L4 profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Fast L4 profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
